svg.title: Stage clusters and the breadth of ChatGPT uses
svg.desc: Left: the full 56-tool matrix, with neutral outlines highlighting the search and synthesis rows in the rule-based group and screening, quality assessment and extraction in the supervised group. Right: a separately enlarged ChatGPT column aligned to the same eight stage labels. ChatGPT has mapped uses in seven stages; its certainty-assessment cell stays blank. The different panel scales must not be read as a comparison of prevalence or performance.
